name: Yamaha WR400F / WR426F
engine: 399 or 426 cc liquid-cooled five-valve single, wide-ratio gearbox
intro: The enduro versions of the YZ400F and YZ426F. Many have been plated for road use.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Yamaha dealer to run the VIN as well.
